name: go-passkeys-icloud-keychain-use

source.copyright: The go-passkeys authors (the repository carries the Apache-2.0 licence and no copyright line)

authenticator: iCloud Keychain (Apple Passwords), a synced passkey
client: Chromium, or a browser that writes client data as the specification's algorithm does; judged by the members of the client data and their order: type, challenge, origin, crossOrigin
note: The source gives the public key as a SubjectPublicKeyInfo. It is written here as the COSE_Key of the same point, the way an authenticator writes one.
